# STILLROOM design

This is a separate fictional brand within the Kishu example collection. Cream and cobalt are deliberate brief commitments. The local shared Bricolage and Geist files preserve the repository's font assets while composition, palette, imagery, and task flow distinguish this studio from the surrounding site.

The first surface is Persuade: large measured lettering, a warm original studio photograph, and a direct workshop action. The workshop list transitions to Operate: native filters and radios, open rows, explicit capacity, one reservation panel, readable totals, and an inline review and confirmation sequence. There are no payment, account, or personal data fields.

The hero photograph receives a single brief settling entrance on desktop; everything is visible by default. Reduced motion removes spatial motion and smooth scrolling. The arched photograph, slightly angled printed sign, crisp original asterisk, and fine horizontal rules supply the tactile character without decorative card grids.

Above 760px, open workshop rows sit beside a sticky cobalt reservation panel. At 760px and below the panel follows the rows; choosing a workshop brings it into view and focuses its heading. Phone rows retain their thumbnail and readable copy. Supporting text is at least 12px. The active radio, quantity limits, validation, review, confirmation, and reset all have explicit visual and semantic states.
